design.population: unique works in frozen retrieval-v1 manifest after Top50 calibration exclusion

randomization.algorithm: SHA-256 UTF-8 with NUL separators; lexicographic digest order; canonical_work_id tie-break

calibration_exclusion.rule: exclude any work matching a Top50 seed by normalized DOI, arXiv identity, ISBN identity when available, or conservative normalized title+publication-year equality

claim_sampling.selection: retain all when <=3; otherwise deterministic SHA-256 rank using work_id + source_locator + exact_source_span_digest

diagnostics.year: retain publication year; any report bands must be frozen from pre-outcome bibliographic metadata
diagnostics.field_topic: diagnostic/balance/sensitivity only; never a hard eligibility criterion in v1

precision.note: normal/binomial-style references only; clustered literature is not IID

null_schedule.method: deterministic SHA-256-ranked single-cycle target rotation per permutation index

freeze_state.authorization_condition: freeze precision/cost tradeoff using basis-blind operational data before any held-out decomposition outcome is inspected

statistical_units.claim_analysis_unit: selected held-out ClaimIR row under the frozen within-work cap

sampling_weights.primary_work_draw: equal-probability hash-ranked draw from the declared held-out work population
sampling_weights.work_level_population_weighting: equal weights for PRIMARY work rows unless a future version explicitly introduces disproportionate primary strata
sampling_weights.claim_level_scope: coverage under the frozen capped-claim protocol, not a census-weighted estimate over every claim in every eligible paper

denominator_contract.primary_analyzable_denominator: selected held-out claims that are eligible, source-accessible, extraction-successful, IR-valid, and reach a scientific terminal outcome under the frozen decomposition stack
denominator_contract.no_valid_witness_rule: RESIDUAL requires completion of the frozen semantic witness-search/decomposition contract with no accepted witness; generator, tooling, or formal-execution failure alone remains a failure-layer state

eligibility_prevalence.point_estimate: N_INCLUDED / (N_INCLUDED + N_EXCLUDED) among determinately adjudicated sampled works

required_separation: Pr(verified decomposition | eligible, analyzable, frozen held-out claim protocol)

paper_cluster_bootstrap.draws_per_replicate: number of analyzable work clusters, sampled with replacement
paper_cluster_bootstrap.within_cluster_rule: all selected analyzable claims from a resampled work travel together
paper_cluster_bootstrap.uniform_index_method: SHA-256 rejection mapping to [0, n_clusters) using replicate and draw position
paper_cluster_bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles using Type-7 linear quantiles

uncertainty.additional_lineage_clusters: do not fabricate laboratory/framework/dataset lineage clusters unless an outcome-blind metadata contract is separately frozen

expansion_policy.future_expansion_rule: requires a versioned protocol change frozen before any real held-out decomposition outcome is inspected
